owner: OS Product (#410). Release owns the adapter; this states inputs only.
proves: the patched handlers and overlays type-check and compile on the real classpath, plus the generated aconfig values. Not R8, manifest merge, APK resources, packaging, signing or runtime.
provenance: every hash here is an expected value derived from pinned public sources and the committed patches; an adapter compares current bytes with them and never records current bytes as provenance
candidatePatches: every project in the trusted patcher's own registration order for frankel's applyArgs (re-pinned 2026-11-07 to the live apply-os-changes.py): frameworks/base through rose-edge-wmshell.patch and rose-shade-systemui.patch, build/release, and Launcher3 switcher, rose-edge and rose-edge-resize. #440's candidateDelta is retired and empty, so a tree integrated by this patcher is at these final images

branches.verifyIntegrated: every affected file equals post (config.xml only through integrationRewrite with its bound inputs), every required overlay is present with its sha256 (notAnInput overlays may be present with any bytes), every unlisted path matches its treePin, no extra path, no patch is applied again
branches.reconstruct: every affected file equals pre (sha256 and gitBlob at revision), new files and every overlay target are absent beforehand, patches are applied in order and must give exactly post; required overlays are then copied; every unlisted path matches its treePin, no extra path

verifyBaseApplyCandidate.status: proposal, stated as data only: Release implements it, and any run needs separate authority

conditions.text: the integrating bundle matches base.bundleContent; every affected file of every project equals base.projects post (config.xml only through integrationRewrite with its bound inputs); every required base overlay is present with its sha256 (notAnInput overlays may be present with any bytes); every unlisted path matches the project treePin; no extra path
every candidateDelta file and overlay is at its before image, or absent where before is null; anything at after, or neither, refuses

in an isolated copy only, each candidateDelta patch (sha256-checked bytes at bundlePath) passes candidateDelta.application, and each candidateDelta overlay is copied from its sha256-checked bundlePath
the copy then equals projects and overlays exactly, with the same treePin and config.xml rules; only then does the compile proceed

verifyBaseApplyCandidate.otherwise: refuse at the first failed condition, naming its id; partial, already applied or unknown state refuses

branches.otherwise: A tree integrated by an older patcher (for example Launcher3 switcher only) is such a state and is refused: with candidateDelta empty, no branch completes it. Never reset or trust a snapshot.

verifyIntegrated: Git metadata or objects of the three contract projects in the checked tree (the lunch inputs' admitted gitRequirement.publicFetch of vendor/adevtool/.git, outside them, excepted)

definitions.sourceTree: the checked tree, bound by Infra provenance (path and run), never by this contract
definitions.lunch: the lunch inputs in lunchInputs, satisfied on the copy
definitions.policyReceipt: the integrating run's own --background-policy file, associated with this tree by Infra provenance (run, source path, receipt hash recorded by that run); a receipt reconstructed from config.xml or any other tree file is refused
definitions.reconstructSource: an approved source of genuine Git objects for each project at revision (read from a repository, never bytes hashed from the checked tree); none is approved
definitions.bundleReport: a document in base.bundleReport's form from its stated producer

integrationRewrite.by: scripts/apply-os-changes.py, the `if policy:` block, after patching

generatingInputs.policyReceipt: agent, targets, prototypeControl; its sha256 must equal the one bound for that tree outside this contract; it is the integrating run's own --background-policy file (branches.definitions.policyReceipt), never one reconstructed from config.xml or any other tree file

inputRules.rows: every agent and target row has a packageName and at least one certificate

arrays.config_pixelComputerControlTargets: Targets: every target row, in receipt order
arrays.config_pixelComputerControlPrototypeAgen: PrototypeAgents: the agent row, only when prototypeControl is true; otherwise the marker

templates.config_pixelComputerControlReferenceDisp: <string name="config_pixelComputerControlReferenceDisplayAddress" translatable="false">{address}</string> when given; otherwise the marker

compare: each element name opens exactly once in the file
each element is exactly its expected text (template from the bound inputs, or its marker)
replacing exactly those texts with their markers gives post (sha256); nothing else is normalised
a missing input or binding, a value outside inputRules, or any other difference refuses

treePin.source: revision is the pinned commit; rootTree is that commit's tree, recomputed offline from the listing (every tree object rebuilt and hashed); neither is a host fact

listing.format: <mode> SP <type> SP <oid> TAB <path> LF, as git ls-tree -r --full-tree <revision> prints it, gzip-compressed with mtime 0

unlisted.excludedAre: exactly this project's files paths and overlay targets, relative to it; no globs. A path the pinned tree lacks (a new file or an overlay target) must be absent from it and excludes nothing
unlisted.recordFormat: <mode> SP <oid> TAB <path> LF, with path relative to the project

treePin.gitlinks: none: generation refuses any mode 160000 entry

blobHash.regularFile: git hash-object -t blob --no-filters --stdin, given the file's bytes
blobHash.symlink: git hash-object -t blob --no-filters --stdin, given readlink's bytes (no trailing newline); mode 120000
blobHash.implementation: git's own collision-detecting SHA-1, through that invocation; the offline generator's blob and tree ids are confirmed against git hash-object by os/tests/test_launcher3_compile_contract.py

treePin.extraPaths: any file present in the source project that is neither in this tree, a listed affected file nor an overlay target is refused
treePin.limitation: per-path sha256 would need every file's contents, which the bounded pinned fixtures do not hold; the pin is mode and git blob id per path from the pinned commit's own tree objects, with this sha256 digest over them

other pinned projects lunch needs are at the integrating run's state (Infra provenance); projects the integration also patches (build/make, packages/modules/Permission, packages/apps/Updater) and paths it generates (packages/apps/RosePreinstall/*, PixelBackgroundControl/Agent.apk) are not at their pinned revision and are not inputs of this proof
the generated vendor module and the lunch markers: lunchInputs
notInputs: the policy receipt in reconstruct (verifyIntegrated, and verifyBaseApplyCandidate's base-exact and final-exact, need it, bound, to check config.xml)
frameworks/base overlays (WindowManager-Shell, SystemUI-core: not on the library classpath)
outputsToBind: Soong source and resource lists of Launcher3QuickStepLib contain every Launcher3 post-image and required overlay at these hashes
its javac/kotlinc classpath contains the patched framework (AutomatedPackageListener declares onAutomatedDevicesChanged)
flagEvidence: each flag's expectedLine from its own aconfig_declarations module output
lunch product, variant, BUILD_ID and release-config maps in effect

base.match: the integrating bundle's source contents (the patches it applied to these projects and the overlays it copied into them, as Infra reports them) must equal bundleContent exactly; any other bundle does not match and refuses

registration.derivation: executed: scripts/apply-os-changes.py's own argument parser with applyArgs (each placeholder an empty file), then its statements from `projects = {...}` through `projects.update(rose_home_projects(preinstalls))`, with validate_policy and preinstall_plan replaced because they check data and never registration; the result is filtered to this contract's projects. rose_home_projects adds only packages/modules/Permission
registration.contractDerived: the bundle report's only contract-derived input: names and order, used only once the receipt's patcher sha256 and the run's applyArgs equal these

bundleReport.producer: Release's producer script at a reviewed commit; never the adapter, the observer or this checker
association: run is entered by review from GitHub run metadata (no live API, no actions:read), with the recipe lines at headSha that make the run commit both the candidate and the trusted checkout; headSha is reachable from main
exactly one *-<label>.json with receiptType reconcile and the same label, its at within [createdAt, updatedAt]
receipt.patcher.patcher is trusted and its three sha256 equal both the files at headSha and base.registration.patcher: a consistency check, not association (many commits share those bytes)

observed.patches: base.registration.order, each with the sha256 of headSha:os/patches/<name>
observed.overlays: every headSha:os/overlays file whose target is under a required prefix
observed.notAnInputOverlays: the present targets on the exact notAnInput allowlist
observed.unclassified: anything else under the three projects; must be empty

rules: only observed minus unclassified is compared with base.bundleContent, and unclassified must be empty
observed is computed from history before bundleContent is read; tampering bundleContent leaves it unchanged
a report missing any section, or a bare bundleContent, is refused
receipt changed/entries are association only, never observed
the report never stands in for base-exact on the copy

application.where: only in the isolated copy, never in the source tree
application.note: whitespace is left unchanged; any failure of --check refuses before anything is applied

candidateDelta.pathConvention: files[].path and overlays[].target are relative to the source tree root (project path first); projects[].files[].path and base.projects[].files[].path are relative to their project; bundlePath and bundle[].path are relative to the repository root

flags.readBy: android.security.flags-aconfig-java (framework), which ActivityThread and ActivityRecord read
flags.produce: build out/soong/.intermediates/frameworks/base/android.security.flags-aconfig/aconfig-flags.txt as an explicit goal with Launcher3QuickStepLib, or decode aconfig-cache.pb with that tree's host aconfig using the identical dump-cache --dedup --format='{fully_qualified_name}:{permission}={state:bool}'
flags.accept: exactly one line for the flag, equal to expectedLine, in the module's own output; absent, duplicated, another module or another value: result incomplete (identity flag unresolved); not a refusal of the inputs

flags.produce: build out/soong/.intermediates/packages/apps/Launcher3/aconfig/com_android_launcher3_flags/aconfig-flags.txt as an explicit goal with Launcher3QuickStepLib, or decode aconfig-cache.pb with that tree's host aconfig using the identical dump-cache --dedup --format='{fully_qualified_name}:{permission}={state:bool}'
flags.accept: exactly one line for the flag, equal to expectedLine, in the module's own output; absent, duplicated, another module or another value: result incomplete (identity flag unresolved); not a refusal of the inputs

flagEvidence.role: output: never a precondition of any branch

required.rule: present with exactly its sha256 in overlays

notAnInput.rule: exact target only: present with any bytes, or absent; excluded from its project's treePin by exact path (treePin.unlisted.excludedPaths); never a source of Launcher3QuickStepLib, a compileGoals entry or a flagEvidence input. Adding or removing one changes the contract

identitySharing.consumer: Home (workspace/rose-agent, #442): MainActivity.gestureContract replies to gesture_nav_contract_v1 only after GestureContract.caller accepts getCurrentCaller() as the config_recentsComponentName package with a shared uid, on SDK 35+, RectF only; no dedicated exported entry
